case_scope: United States heirs property and cloudy-title subsystem case for title finality, disaster repair, and asset conversion

title_probate_finality.note: Heirs property is explicitly a title/succession problem that can prevent owners from using full ownership benefits.

claim_conversion_friction.note: Property claims and disaster assistance can fail without acceptable proof of ownership/occupancy.

housing_land_washout.note: Partition, legal cost, and inability to finance repairs can wash out family property.

climate_insurance_drag.note: Disaster repair claims are harder when title/occupancy proof is weak.

group_person_closure.note: Need direct race/place/subgroup title-cloud data; history and available evidence suggest anti-averaging pressure.

legal_identity_documentation_access.note: Documentation rules are a live gate for repair and aid conversion.

proof_debt: national heirs-property prevalence by race/place/urban-rural/disaster exposure
rates of disaster-aid denial for title or occupancy proof
partition sale and predatory buyout data
cost and time to clear title by subgroup

opening_package.first_lane: title clearing legal aid and probate simplification
opening_package.second_lane: disaster alternative documentation and repair grants
opening_package.monitoring_lane: title clearance, disaster aid approvals, partition filings, repair financing, and land retention

reopening_triggers: major disaster exposes cloudy-title denial rates
states adopt or repeal partition protections
new national heirs-property data become available

threshold_moments.why: Repair, disaster, sale, and inheritance moments can fail without defensible title.

anti_averaging.why: Likely racialized/place closure requires direct subgroup data.

conversion_rails.why: The asset cannot fully convert into repair, aid, credit, or sale value without documentation.

evidence_debt_register.question: Which households lose disaster aid or repair finance because of title/occupancy proof?
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: FEMA/HUD/state disaster program denial data by title status and subgroup

evidence_debt_register.question: What is the national and local prevalence of heirs property by race and place?
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: registry/tax assessor research and local court/title data

validation_notes: Subsystem case; should be compared with U.S. climate-insurance and racialized closure cases.
